head: 7706d22aeab2f8a72fd3197bdb14816dc5a5ffc8
claim: A LAN pairing server now listens only on the addresses it offered the phone, not on every interface of the computer

steps.start: Worktree on fm/byk-discover-lan-bind at 7706d22a with the workspace built (packages/discover/dist present). No scratch consumer existed; no servers were running.
steps: Read the verify skill and the discover-lan-bind feature recipe.
Wrote a Node consumer in a scratch directory inside the worktree that imports reach and routes from @byokit/discover.
Read this computer's LAN addresses with routes(); it reported one LAN address, 192.168.1.144.
Called reach({ port, via: 'lan' }) on a free loopback-chosen port and printed the bind list and the dial URLs.
Checked that the bind list is non-empty, has no wildcard, and covers the host of every URL.
Started one HTTP server per bind address on that port and requested each one over HTTP; each answered 204.
Connected to 127.0.0.1 on the same port; the connection was refused (ECONNREFUSED).
Took the same port on 127.0.0.1 with a second server; it succeeded.
Closed every server the run started.
Called reach({ port, via: 'lan', interfaces: {} }) and printed the rejection it raised.
Ran the consumer and captured its stdout, stderr and exit code to discover-lan-bind.txt; the exit code was 0.
Removed the scratch directory; the evidence file remained.
steps.result: The output shows bind ['192.168.1.144'] and urls ['ws://192.168.1.144:<port>']. Port answers 204 on 192.168.1.144 and is refused on 127.0.0.1, and 127.0.0.1 can still take that port. With no interfaces the call rejects with 'no LAN address; connect to a network or choose Tailscale'. Exit code 0.

verdicts.seen: I read the one capture entry. It shows bind: ["192.168.1.144"], urls: ["ws://192.168.1.144:44191"], and 'listening on 192.168.1.144:44191'. A GET to the LAN address returned 204. A GET to 127.0.0.1:44191 was refused with ECONNREFUSED, and 'loopback 127.0.0.1:44191 taken by a second server: yes' shows the refusal is from the port being held elsewhere, not from our server listening there. The error case 'no LAN address; connect to a network or choose Tailscale' shows the offered-address check. The outcome names no separate parts, so parts is empty.
